_comment: Copy this to projects.json and fill in your projects. projects.json is gitignored. Each key is the name a caller uses (./ask.sh "fix vulns in <name>"). 'assets' are the Vanta vulnerable-asset names to pull findings for; run `vanta-findings <name>` to check they resolve. 'owner.slack_id' is the Slack member id (U...) tagged in every channel message.
